## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Docs travelled with the code (public API, widget options, model providers, env vars, Compose), or the PR body says `[skip docs]` and why
- [ ] No business strategy, competitor comparisons or authoring narration in code, comments or docs (`.ai/README.md`)
- [ ] Nothing outside `packages/ee` imports from it; MIT packages import no AGPL package
